components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary operational action with compact height and restrained feedback.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; min-height: 2.25rem; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; border: 0; border-radius: 0.625rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); font: 500 0.875rem/1.25rem ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 1px 2px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 90%, black); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action that preserves the calm surface hierarchy.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; min-height: 2.25rem; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; border: 1px solid var(--input); border-radius: 0.625rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; background: var(--background); color: var(--foreground); font: 500 0.875rem/1.25rem ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 1px 2px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-foreground); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Labeled compact field with semantic border and explicit focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 0.5rem; color: var(--foreground); font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; } .ds-field-input { min-height: 2.25rem; width: 100%; border: 1px solid var(--input); border-radius: 0.625rem; padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem; background: transparent; color: var(--foreground); font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.25rem; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 1px 2px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); transition: color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-field-input:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-field-help { color: var(--muted-foreground); font-size: 0.75rem; line-height: 1rem; }

components.description: Bordered tonal container for metrics, summaries, and grouped operations.

components.css: .ds-card { border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 1rem; padding: 1.5rem; background: var(--card); color: var(--card-foreground); box-shadow: 0 1px 3px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 1px 2px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-card-label, .ds-card-note { margin: 0; color: var(--muted-foreground); font-size: 0.75rem; line-height: 1rem; } .ds-card-value { display: block; margin: 0.5rem 0; font-size: 1.5rem; line-height: 1; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Compact status cue that always carries explicit text.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0.625rem; padding: 0.125rem 0.625rem; background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); font: 600 0.75rem/1rem ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 1px 2px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-status:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 80%, transparent); }

components.name: Sidebar Navigation Item
components.description: Active Admin navigation with tonal surface, explicit marker, and readable label.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { position: relative; display: flex; min-height: 2.5rem; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; border-radius: 0.75rem; padding: 0.625rem 0.75rem; background: var(--primary-soft); color: var(--sidebar-accent-foreground); font: 500 0.875rem/1.25rem ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: all 200ms ease-in-out; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: var(--sidebar-accent); color: var(--sidebar-accent-foreground); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--sidebar-ring); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav-marker { width: 0.125rem; height: 1.5rem; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--primary); }

components.description: Contained operational decision surface with title, consequence copy, and ordered actions.

components.css: .ds-dialog { width: min(32rem, calc(100vw - 2rem)); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 0.75rem; padding: 1.5rem; background: var(--background); color: var(--foreground); box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 4px 6px -4px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-dialog:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-dialog-title { margin: 0; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-dialog-copy { margin: 0.75rem 0 1.5rem; color: var(--muted-foreground); font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-dialog-actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 0.5rem; } .ds-dialog-primary, .ds-dialog-secondary { min-height: 2.25rem; border-radius: 0.625rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; } .ds-dialog-primary { border: 0; background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); } .ds-dialog-secondary { border: 1px solid var(--input); background: var(--background); color: var(--foreground); } .ds-dialog-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 90%, black); } .ds-dialog-secondary:hover { background: var(--accent); } .ds-dialog-primary:focus-visible, .ds-dialog-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
“Pusat Kendali Hunian” memperlakukan setiap layar operasional sebagai permukaan kendali yang tenang: informasi cukup padat untuk kerja harian, tetapi hierarki, jarak, dan penekanan yang restrained membuatnya mudah dipindai. Permukaan tonal dan border terukur membawa struktur; shadow bersifat sekunder dan tidak dekoratif.

Shared core memakai role warna semantic light/dark, kontrol ringkas, focus state yang jelas, dan layout responsif yang wrap sebelum overflow. Admin mengutamakan tabel property-wide dan kepadatan navigasi, sedangkan Penghuni memakai shell mobile sempit dengan radius, gradient, dan elevation yang sedikit lebih lunak.
keyCharacteristics: Kepadatan operasional yang nyaman dengan hierarki eksplisit.
Tonal layering, border terukur, dan shadow minimal.
Komponen refined dan restrained yang mempertahankan implementasi incumbent.

rules.name: The Semantic Surface Rule
rules.body: Gunakan role background, foreground, card, muted, border, dan state semantic agar light dan dark mode tetap ekuivalen.

rules.name: The Wrap Before Overflow Rule
rules.body: Pada layar sempit, stack atau wrap kontrol dan pertahankan content di dalam viewport; jangan sembunyikan operasi penting hanya agar layout muat.

rules.name: The Restrained Depth Rule
rules.body: Gunakan border dan kontras tonal lebih dahulu; simpan shadow untuk kontrol, floating surface, dan feedback interaksi terbatas.

dos: Do pertahankan role semantic light/dark dan focus-visible state yang terbaca.
Do jaga informasi operasional padat tetapi terkelompok, berlabel, dan mudah dipindai.
Do dampingi setiap warna status dengan teks, ikon, atau cue eksplisit lain.
Do jauhkan opaque identifier, rahasia autentikasi, dan metadata privat dari UI yang dirender.
Do beri setiap form control label terlihat, validasi inline, dan focus management yang disengaja.
donts: Don't redesign sistem incumbent atau memperkenalkan palette, font, radius, atau bahasa komponen yang tidak terkait.
Don't bergantung pada warna saja untuk menyampaikan status, sukses, peringatan, atau kegagalan.
Don't biarkan tabel, header, dialog, atau action row membuat horizontal page overflow.
Don't promosikan keputusan layout khusus satu halaman menjadi aturan desain global.
Don't gunakan shadow berat atau efek dekoratif sebagai pengganti hierarki.
